title: Meta Graph
statement: The task is to find the shortest path from w_x to y_z in the n²-vertex meta-graph of a graph G (n, m up to 2·10^5), where pair (a,b) moves its second coordinate along a G-edge or swaps to (b,a) when a~b. Viewed as two leapfrogging tokens, it reduces to BFS distances plus a three-layer shortest path minimising dist(x,a)+3·dist(a,b)+dist(b,z) over a adjacent to w, b adjacent to y.
